title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378 (Saving and construction of enactments conferring power to wind up partnership firm, association or company, etc., in certain cases)

content.overview: Nothing in this Part shall affect the operation of any enactment which provides for any partnership, association or company being wound up, or being wound up as an unregistered company, under the Indian Companies Act, 1913 or any previous company law, or which confers power on any court or authority to order such winding up; and such enactments shall continue to apply as if this Act had not been passed, with necessary adaptations for references to this Act and the Tribunal.
content.glance: Earlier enactments conferring power to wind up partnerships/associations as unregistered companies continue to operate with adaptations.
